ns2:course.label: Newsgathering Across Platforms
ns2:course.description: Fundamentals of journalistic reporting and writing across print, broadcast and digital platforms. Credit is not given for JOUR 210 if credit for JOUR 400 has been earned. Prerequisite: JOUR 200.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Credit is not given for JOUR 210 if credit for JOUR 400 has been earned. Prerequisite: JOUR 200.
ns2:course.classScheduleInformation: Students must register for one lab and one lecture section.
